LaunchId.description: A launch: one process lifetime of a thread.

ThreadId.description: A thread: one agent conversation across all its launches.

row.description: Zero-based cell coordinates in the grid.

description:
The body of `GET /api/threads/{thread_id}/screen`: the live screen of the thread's current
launch, one text line per row. The daemon builds it with [`ScreenResponse::new`], which
keeps the serialized body within [`SCREEN_MAX_BODY`].

cursor.description: In cell coordinates (a wide character takes two columns).

lines.description:
Exactly `rows` lines, top to bottom: each row's cells without the second half of a
wide character, combining characters kept, trailing spaces trimmed.

truncated.description: Some line was cut to keep the body within its bound.

title: ScreenResponse
